g.text: 12 new games in 6 randomized blocks | every game starts from empty history
Each block contains two separately generated full games assigned to H and H+L; no shared-prefix continuation.
The primary outcome includes all sender charges and recipient losses. Old pilot games are excluded.
The interval summarizes six block differences; it is exploratory, model dependent and not a power guarantee.
